claim: Free and open source vector graphics editor for illustrations such as logos, clip art, typography, diagrams, flowcharts
Uses SVG as main format; feature list: shapes, paths, text, markers, clones, gradients, node editing, layers, text-on-path, SVG XML editing
Imports EPS, Postscript, JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF; exports PNG and multiple vector formats
Lightweight core with features added as extensions
Most source code under GNU GPL version 2 or later
